what_this_is: One fingerprint per .glb in testing/_deploy/models. Content hash, byte size, vertex count, and the hull's own bounding box. Purpose: detect when a model CHANGES, without waiting for CIG to announce anything.
why: A ship rework changes the hull. If a Constellation .glb ever stops matching its fingerprint here, that is evidence of a rework that arrived before, or instead of, an announcement. Same test works for all 235 models.

how_measured.renderer: 174 models decoded in a real GL context; verts and bbox read off the decoded mesh
how_measured.gltf-accessor: 61 models read from the glTF JSON chunk only: POSITION accessor count and min/max, no DRACO decode needed
how_measured.cross_check: the four Carrack files were measured two files by each method and agree to 0.002 units, which is why both methods sit in one table

units: bbox and extent are in the MODEL's own units, which are not consistent across the library. scale_class and model_units_per_metre say which. Never compare extents across ships without them.
geometry_match_tolerance: identical vertex count AND every bounding-box extent within 0.1% relative. The tolerance exists because 174 models were measured through a renderer and 61 from the glTF header; the two agree to about 0.002 units on the four Carracks, which is the only overlap available to calibrate against.
